beats.label: S1 · Three years after
beats.text: Three years after the Sudden Departure erased 2% of humanity, Mapleton chief Kevin Garvey polices a town on edge while his wife Laurie has silently joined the Guilty Remnant cult.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the world, Kevin's role, and Laurie's defection — the pressure the whole season sits on.

beats.label: S1 · Tom and Wayne
beats.text: Kevin's son Tom follows the messianic Holy Wayne, and after federal agents raid the compound he is left on the run protecting Wayne's pregnant teenage girl Christine.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the baby Tom eventually delivers back to Mapleton, which lands on Kevin's porch.

beats.label: S1 · Blackouts
beats.text: Kevin begins waking in strange places with no memory, and after visiting his institutionalised father who hears voices, he quietly fears he is losing his own mind.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The blackout thread and the inherited-madness question drive Kevin's whole arc from here on.

beats.label: S1 · Kevin and Nora
beats.text: Grieving widow Nora Durst, who lost her husband and both children in the Departure, crosses paths with Kevin at divorce court and the two begin a tentative romance.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the relationship the rest of the series is about.

beats.label: S1 · Patti in the woods
beats.text: Kevin comes to in the woods with GR leader Patti bound beside him from a blackout he cannot recall; when he tries to free her, she slits her own throat to trap him with it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Patti's suicide is the guilt Kevin carries — and the voice that haunts him — going into next season.

beats.label: S1 · Mapleton burns the GR
beats.text: The Guilty Remnant plant lifelike replicas of the departed inside townspeople's homes, and enraged Mapleton stones and torches the cult's houses with Jill, newly a recruit, trapped inside.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The riot ends the Mapleton chapter and forces the family to reassemble.

beats.label: S1 · The baby on the porch
beats.text: Kevin drags Jill from the fire and Laurie screams for the first time in months; Tom returns with Christine's abandoned baby, and Nora, about to leave town, finds the child on Kevin's porch.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the tableau the next season opens from — the family rebuilt around a strange baby.

cliffhanger.text: Mapleton has burned the Guilty Remnant to the ground. Kevin, Jill, Tom and Nora stand on the porch with an abandoned baby in Nora's arms, while Laurie, having finally spoken, is nowhere in the picture.
questions: Whose baby is now in Nora's arms and what does the family do with her?
Will Laurie stay with what's left of the Guilty Remnant after breaking her silence to save Jill?
Are Kevin's blackouts the same madness that took his father, or something else?

characters.name: Kevin Garvey
characters.line: Mapleton's police chief; suffering blackouts he can't explain; buried Patti after her suicide and has just pulled Jill from a burning house.

characters.name: Laurie Garvey
characters.line: Kevin's estranged wife and a senior Guilty Remnant member; broke her vow of silence to warn Kevin that Jill was in the fire.

characters.name: Jill Garvey
characters.line: Kevin's teenage daughter, alienated by Laurie's absence; briefly joined the GR before Kevin rescued her.

characters.name: Tom Garvey
characters.line: Kevin's stepson and a disillusioned Holy Wayne follower; has just returned to Mapleton carrying Christine's newborn to find Laurie.

characters.name: Nora Durst
characters.line: Widow who lost her husband and both children in the Departure; a DSD fraud investigator now beginning a relationship with Kevin.

characters.name: Patti Levin
characters.line: Leader of the Guilty Remnant; slit her own throat in front of Kevin during his blackout to leave him with the body.

characters.name: Matt Jamison
characters.line: Local pastor and Nora's brother, who preaches that many of the departed were sinners; helped Kevin bury Patti.

characters.name: Meg Abbott
characters.line: Recent Guilty Remnant recruit under Laurie, grieving her mother's death just before the Departure.

characters.name: Kevin Garvey Sr.
characters.line: Kevin's father and Mapleton's previous chief; institutionalised for hearing voices, and lately claims to have a mission.

beats.label: S2 · Move to Miracle
beats.text: Kevin, Nora, Jill and the adopted baby Lily leave Mapleton for Jarden, Texas — a national-park town called Miracle where nobody departed — and move in next door to firefighter John Murphy's family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the show's location and introduces the Murphys, who share the season with the Garveys.

beats.label: S2 · The girls vanish
beats.text: On the Garveys' first night in Jarden an earthquake drains the town's lake and John's daughter Evie disappears with two friends, their car left running by the empty water.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The disappearance drives John's arc and eventually breaks Miracle open.

beats.label: S2 · Kevin at the lake
beats.text: Kevin wakes at the bottom of the drained lake with a cinderblock tied to his ankle, and his handprint is soon found on Evie's abandoned car — another blackout he cannot explain.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ties Kevin directly to the missing girls and puts him on a collision course with John.

beats.label: S2 · Killing Patti in the hotel
beats.text: Hallucinating dead Patti at every turn, Kevin drinks poison on an old shaman's promise and wakes in a hotel-limbo where, posing as an assassin, he drowns Patti to finally be rid of her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kevin's first death and return sets up his belief that he cannot die.

beats.label: S2 · Meg goes militant
beats.text: Laurie, now out of the GR and running a support group with Tom, watches Meg turn the cult violent; Meg rapes Tom and begins planning a strike on Miracle itself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Meg's escalation is the engine of the finale's assault.

beats.label: S2 · Evie was never lost
beats.text: Tom finds Evie and her friends alive in a Guilty Remnant trailer — they faked their Departure to join Meg — and John, learning the handprint is Kevin's, shoots Kevin dead in his own home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Detonates two threads at once: the mystery of the girls and Kevin's second death.

beats.label: S2 · The bridge and the return
beats.text: Kevin claws his way out of a shallow grave as the GR breach Miracle and Evie coldly refuses her weeping parents; he walks home to find Nora, Jill, Laurie, Tom, Matt, Mary and Lily waiting inside.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season ends with the whole cast gathered under Kevin's roof — the launchpad for the finale season.

cliffhanger.text: Miracle has been overrun by the Guilty Remnant and Evie has revealed she is with them. Kevin has died and come back a second time, and finds his entire scattered family sitting in his living room.
questions: Can John and Erika live with a daughter who chose to disappear from them?
Is Kevin genuinely unable to die, and what does that make him?
Was Miracle ever special, or did the girls' fake Departure prove it never was?

characters.name: Kevin Garvey
characters.line: Now living in Jarden; blacked out the night the girls vanished; has died and come back twice, first by poison and then from John's bullet.

characters.name: Nora Durst
characters.line: Living with Kevin in Miracle and raising baby Lily; investigated as a possible 'Lens' that causes departures around her.

characters.name: Jill Garvey
characters.line: Living with Kevin and Nora in Jarden and strained by Kevin's unraveling, but no longer in the GR.

characters.name: John Murphy
characters.line: Miracle firefighter who insists the town is not special; shot Kevin over Evie's disappearance before breaking down with him in the chaos.

characters.name: Erika Murphy
characters.line: John's wife and Evie's mother, a doctor who had been planning to leave John and blames herself for Evie's disappearance.

characters.name: Evie Murphy
characters.line: John and Erika's teenage daughter, who faked her own Departure to join the Guilty Remnant.

characters.name: Meg Abbott
characters.line: Now the militant face of the Guilty Remnant; raped Tom and led the assault that broke through the Miracle bridge.

characters.name: Tom Garvey
characters.line: Has broken with Laurie's deprogramming work; located the missing girls inside the GR camp.

characters.name: Laurie Garvey
characters.line: Out of the GR entirely; working as a therapist for former members and trying to hold Tom and Kevin together.

characters.name: Matt Jamison
characters.line: Pastor in Jarden, caring for pregnant comatose wife Mary who briefly woke on their first night there.

characters.name: Patti Levin
characters.line: Manifested all season as Kevin's hallucination and was finally drowned by him in a hotel-limbo, freeing him of her voice.

beats.label: S3 · Seven years on
beats.text: Three years after the GR were droned off the bridge, the seventh Departure anniversary looms: Kevin polices Jarden, Laurie has married John, and Matt is secretly writing a gospel of Kevin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the board and plants Matt's book, which many characters end up chasing.

beats.label: S3 · Nora and the machine
beats.text: Nora is contacted by scientists claiming a radioactive machine can send her to wherever her children went; she chases the fraud all the way to Australia and Kevin follows her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The machine is the object the whole season resolves around.

beats.label: S3 · Kevin Sr. in the outback
beats.text: Kevin Sr. is already in the Australian outback, convinced that a flood will end the world on the anniversary and that only he, armed with an Aboriginal chant, can stop it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the prophecy the finale tests and gives Kevin his father as an anchor abroad.

beats.label: S3 · Melbourne breakup
beats.text: In Melbourne Kevin chases a hallucination of Evie through the streets, fights bitterly with Nora and walks out; alone in the hotel, Nora quietly decides the machine is real and goes back for it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits Kevin and Nora and commits Nora to the machine.

beats.label: S3 · Matt's last voyage
beats.text: Matt sails to Australia to bring Kevin home, revealing his cancer has returned; onboard he meets a man calling himself God who is bored by everything Matt has done in His name.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives Matt his ending and drains the show's religious framework before the finale.

beats.label: S3 · The flood that isn't
beats.text: Persuaded by his father, Kevin drowns himself once more to carry messages to the dead; he returns from a nuclear afterlife to find the sky clear and the prophesied flood never coming.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Retires the apocalypse question and leaves only the personal one — where is Nora.

beats.label: S3 · Book of Nora
beats.text: Years later Nora lives alone in the Australian outback; an aged Kevin finds her, and she tells him the machine did send her — to a mirror world where her family had gone on happily without her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's final image and the answer, or non-answer, to everything.

cliffhanger.text: In a small Australian cottage decades on, elderly Nora has told elderly Kevin the whole story of the machine and the world of the missing 98%, and he says he believes her.
questions: Is Nora telling the truth about the mirror world, or is it the story she needs?
Have Kevin and Nora finally found peace with each other, or only company?
Was there ever anything supernatural at all, or only people making meaning of loss?

characters.name: Kevin Garvey
characters.line: Jarden's police chief who no longer believes he can die and repeatedly tests it; eventually spends the rest of his life searching Australia for Nora.

characters.name: Nora Durst
characters.line: Back at the DSD investigating departure fraud; walks into the machine after her split with Kevin and lives out her life alone in the outback.

characters.name: Matt Jamison
characters.line: Author of a secret gospel casting Kevin as a new Christ; his cancer has returned and he dies before the finale reunion.

characters.name: Kevin Garvey Sr.
characters.line: Living in Australia chasing a chant he believes will stop a flood on the seventh anniversary; recruits Kevin into his prophecy.

characters.name: Laurie Garvey
characters.line: Now married to John Murphy and helping him run a fake-medium business; last seen calmly saying goodbye to her children before a solo scuba dive.

characters.name: John Murphy
characters.line: Married to Laurie; poses as a mentalist channelling the dead in Jarden; travels to Australia to bring Kevin back.

characters.name: Michael Murphy
characters.line: John's devout son, who helped Matt compile the gospel of Kevin and travels with the group to Australia.

characters.name: Grace Playford
characters.line: Australian woman convinced her children departed; killed a police officer named Kevin based on a page from Matt's book, then took Kevin Sr. in.
